card.name: Second word of a proper name or compound
card.fires_on: The last word of a two-part name or term, such as Press after a university, salts after a metal, or Chemical after a company name. It is often in citations or element descriptions.

modes.label: Publisher or title ending
modes.description: The word Press, Relations or Telegraph closes a university, publication or title name in a reference.

modes.label: Chemical compound endings
modes.description: The word salts or an ending like ide follows a metal or element name.
modes.example: Cobalt<< salts>> are used to impart permanent brilliant blue colors

card.writes: No clear single effect; the promoted tokens are mostly Chinese name-like endings and word pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the closing word of a name or compound, like Press after a university or salts after a metal.
